Key.English: Trail the Rest of the Selection

While tracing one route, give every other selected unit of the same kind the same route ending a fixed distance further back, so a column is one gesture instead of six. Only routes nothing has been drawn on are recruited, and grabbing a handle takes that route back under manual control.

Stop the selected units in place for as long as a route is being drawn for them, so they do not walk out from under it. Released when planning ends. Note that a unit already being held still by something else — a LAMBS garrison, for example — is released along with the rest.

Fastest a vehicle will drive a planned route, in km/h. Capped well below most vehicles' top speed on purpose: a vehicle given its full config speed drives a traced route like a time trial and loses the line on the first corner. A group set to Limited speed halves this again.
Nothing in the selection can be given a route

Time in minutes a unit may spend following a planned route before the route is abandoned. A backstop, not the usual way a route ends — it exists so a unit whose destination became unreachable is not still walking towards it hours later.

Opens route planning for the selected units and vehicles: drag the arrow in front of one to trace the path it should take. Press again to execute every route drawn, or Escape to cancel. Selecting a crew member plans for the vehicle he is riding in.
